decisions.reason: The existing message-320 MODIFY already records every GPIO assignment relevant to this Requirement; the reset wiring, touch-controller type, and BOOT placement belong to other behaviors.
The complete mapping identifies the specific panel connector references and adds the slide-switch connector to the previously generic connector inventory.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Here is the complete mapping:

\- The J\_BTN3 panel button is assigned to GPIO6
\- The J\_BTN4 panel button is assigned to GPIO7
\- The J\_SW panel slide switch is assigned to GPIO8
\- The J\_RESET panel reset button connects EN to GND
\- The J\_TOUCH capacitive-touch connector uses TTP223 and is assigned to GPIO11
\- The J\_TOUCH2 capacitive-touch connector uses TTP223 and is assigned to GPIO14
\- The BOOT button is on-board only for development and is not panel-mounted

decisions.reason: The panel-control mapping does not change addressable-LED power, level shifting, or LED data logic.
No decoupling requirement or capacitor configuration is changed by the panel-control mapping.
The source does not change the INA219 monitor or the rail being monitored.
Identifying TTP223 touch inputs and their GPIOs does not alter USB standalone-power activation, capacity, or powered scope.
The source does not change the OR-ing method, power sources, or source-selection behavior.
The panel-control mapping does not address I2C series resistors, pull-ups, or topology.
The source does not change the charge-status LED, GPIO13 assignment, or CHGLED connector circuit.
The main-board panel mapping has no effect on the power-board battery connector, pinout, or placement.
The source concerns local panel inputs and does not modify either interboard connector or its pin assignments.
The EN-to-GND panel reset connection is unrelated to the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology.
